builds.title: Flappy AI Jam Starter
builds.description: The three-life starter. Find your rhythm as the gaps narrow and the game speeds up.

builds.title: Autopilot
builds.description: Watch the game plan its own flight path, then switch the autopilot off and try it yourself.
builds.prompt: Add an autopilot that plans flap-or-coast decisions using the game’s fixed-step physics. Draw its predicted flight path and let me switch back to manual controls. Use three lives and a gradual difficulty ramp. End the demo round after 90 seconds.

builds.title: Voice flight
builds.description: Flap with Space, tap, or your voice. The mic is optional and sound stays on your device.
builds.prompt: Use the browser microphone locally to flap when I speak. Show a spectrum behind the game, and keep Space and tap working if the mic is unavailable. Use three lives, short recovery after hits and a gradual difficulty ramp. Limit each demo round to 90 seconds.

builds.title: Boss rush
builds.description: Meet the boss straight away. Dash through waves that get tougher as you go. Three lives per round.
builds.prompt: Add a Shift or on-screen dash that gives a short shield. Show a slow, clearly signalled boss wave at the start, then alternate gates and boss waves. Use three lives with brief recovery between hits, make each wave tougher, and end the demo round after 90 seconds.
